innovation.summary: Super Cursor introduces innovative elements in the gaming industry, featuring a unique precision platformer gameplay where players control a mouse cursor with its own personality. The game incorporates original characters, soundtracks, and online co-op gameplay, enhancing player engagement. Additionally, AI is utilized for art and sound design, and the digital-only content model minimizes environmental impact.
